column1: # The curation proposal (docs/design/curation-proposal.md): one row per invented or unclear name.
# A row whose proposed name is its current one settles the name. Apply with the verification
# workspace's tools/curation/apply.py. `status` says which accepted list applied a row (the
# current name stays, so a branch can run the list again over what it adds).
